decision: LOCKED / partial domain-specific extension / hardened FASB × Sector 2 private nonprofit four-year closure prediction / not production
validated_lane: FASB × Sector 2 private nonprofit four-year institutions

cluster_bootstrap.design: 1,000 institution-level resamples on the locked test cohort (3,232 rows / 1,644 unique UNITIDs / 117 closure-positive rows / 71 closure-positive UNITIDs); rng seed 20260425.
cluster_bootstrap.interpretation: Cluster-bootstrap CI confirms the lock; paired-difference vs the strongest baseline is positive but its lower bound is +0.002 — higher point estimate, not definitive superiority.

temporal_multi_fold.design: Four sliding train/test time-block folds on the FASB × Sector 2 panel; closure label requires T+5 ≤ 2023, so testable years are 2015–2018.
temporal_multi_fold.interpretation: joint-weak AUROC stays in [0.77, 0.86] across all four folds; tied with simple low-grad-rate baseline in Fold1; A/G has higher point estimate than best baseline by +0.05–0.07 in Folds 2/3/4.

ed_financial_responsibility.design: Descriptive baseline comparator on the FASB × Sector 2 train cohort 2014–2016; 4,495 institution-years × 84 closure-positive rows.
ed_financial_responsibility.source: Urban Institute Education Data Portal API (federal mirror); coverage 2006–2016.
ed_financial_responsibility.interpretation: ED FR is a real closure predictor; head-to-head test on the locked 2017–2018 cohort is not runnable due to data-coverage gap.

hcm_anchor.design: Attempted public-data fetch of the federal Heightened Cash Monitoring list.
hcm_anchor.result: source-blocked in this sandbox (federal endpoints not reachable; Urban does not republish HCM; data.gov has no canonical HCM dataset).
hcm_anchor.interpretation: no HCM evidence added or subtracted; documented as Phase-20 candidate.

closure_lead_time.design: 108 FASB × Sector 2 closures; pre-closure rows scored T-1 through T-5 with the locked Phase-15 transforms.
closure_lead_time.interpretation: joint-weak signal is detectable as early as T-5; multi-year early-warning, not a late-stage acute alarm.
